segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination skin report the toner controls excess sebum and shine without greasiness, and several with oily/acne-prone skin describe less oiliness and smaller-looking pores over time.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report strong hydration without dryness, tightness, or flaking, including one who noticed her skin worsening within weeks of stopping use.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination or T-zone-oily/normal skin report the toner balances both areas and improves forehead texture.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive, reactive, rosacea-prone, or eczema-prone skin overwhelmingly report calming, non-irritating effects with no stinging or flare-ups, though one reviewer with rosacea-prone skin reports red, itchy dry patches appearing in winter.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature skin report glowing, smoother-looking skin and no dryness, with one noting help with skin tone evenness.

concerns.aging: Reviewers who mention aging skin report a brightening or glow effect and smoother-feeling skin over weeks to months of use.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers concerned with dehydration widely report strong, lasting hydration and a plumper, softer feel; one reviewer noticed her skin visibly worsened after stopping use for a few weeks.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with redness, including rosacea, mostly report calming and cooling effects with reduced redness and sensitivity; one reviewer instead reports new red, itchy dry patches appearing in winter.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describing compromised or reactive skin barriers report the toner soothes without stinging or irritation, including use over eczema patches with apparent healing.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers mention dark spots or uneven tone, with one saying the toner has not yet visibly faded dark spots and another reporting a brighter, more even complexion after weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin mostly report clearer skin, fewer breakouts, and improvement in closed comedones; one reports no change in breakouts either way, and one prefers a different toner from the same line for her red acne-prone skin.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers concerned with oiliness report noticeably better oil control and a mattified, non-greasy finish, with some noting smaller-looking pores over continued use.

This has done wonders for my dry, sensitive skin. I've had zero problems using it, even over really angry eczema patches (if anything, it appears to have been helping heal them). I love that it doesn't leave any residue or weird texture after it absorbs, but my skins feels noticeably more hydrated. My pores are less noticeable after having used this toner for a couple months.

I have very very sensitive skin. I have Rosacea, Eczema and acne prone skin. My skin is extremely sensitive. This tiner does not irritate my skin at all. It is very gentle. I saw results after using it only a handful of times. Its amazing. I can't wait to try the other products.

I've been using this toner for the past 2 years. It's very gentle and doesn't irritate the skin. Both of our skins cleared up after switching to this toner and we have acne prone oily skin that is now comb skin. Would recommend to people with similar ski type.
I have oily, acne prone and textured skin and my skin loved this, it's hydrating, doesn't make you look greasy and I've noticed some improvement with my closed comedones

I was gifted a 100ml bottle of this toner, and normally I don't use toner as I find my skin doesn't care if I use it or not. I ended up using the whole bottle because it was easy to use in my routine. After I ran out of it, I didn't replace it for three weeks and during the time that I wasnt using it (even with changing nothing else) my skin was so much worse. I immediately hopped online and bought the 500ml bottle and my skin is finally happy again! No more sensitivity, redness, or flaking. I think I'll probably use this toner forever after seeing how angry my skin got from not using it for a few weeks.
